claim: GitHub search for 'shadow of war' returns several recently created 'Cheats'/'Trainer' repos by unknown accounts that have no relation to the modding community and must be treated as likely malware lures.
evidence: Search results include repos titled 'Middle-earth-Shadow-of-War-Cheats' pushed 2026-10 by new accounts.
verification_method: Observed names/dates in GitHub search API results only; contents not opened.
limitations: Not inspected, so maliciousness is unproven; the pattern (fresh accounts, cheat lures) is a known malware distribution tactic.
next_experiment: Add these to a do-not-download list; restrict third-party sources to the vetted repos listed in this evidence set.
